title: Credential scope widened and lifetime extended
context: Production casework, UK, assisted autonomy with human review

change.description: Credentials move from case:read@15m to case:read@8h plus case:write@8h.

labels.author: Decirance team (unreviewed)
labels.rationale: The credential now authorises writes the contract prohibits (C-16) and exceeds least privilege (C-02). An eight-hour token also changes what revocation means: the shutdown and revocation drill was run against fifteen-minute credentials, so the agreed termination period is no longer evidenced (C-19).
